events.name: Bash
events.head: Mirror commits, cohort deadline, T-093 links
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; gh api 'repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits?per_page=2' --jq '.[]|.sha[0:8]+" "+.commit.committer.date'; grep -n -i 'deadline\|closes' app/src/lib/cohort.ts | head; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare d29a1055 to mirror head for site changes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; gh api 'repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/compare/d29a1055...3da937dd' --jq '.status+" ahead="+(.ahead_by|tostring)+" files: "+([.files[].filename|select(startswith("site/"))]|length|tostring)' 2>&1 | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run key-art probe on live mirror and check links
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; timeout 300 node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs > /tmp/t101-probe.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -c PASS /tmp/t101-probe.txt; grep -i 'fail' /tmp/t101-probe.txt | head; tail -3 /tmp/t101-probe.txt; for u in workshop/ workshop/success/ workshop/join/ vip/ vip/success/ masterclass/success/join/ onboarding/; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} $u\n" "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/${u}?v=d29a1055"; done

events.text: Re-running the key-art probe on the live mirror (no `timeout` binary on macOS).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run key-art probe on live mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; node scripts/probe-keyart.mjs > /tmp/t101-probe.txt 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -ci pass /tmp/t101-probe.txt; grep -i 'fail' /tmp/t101-probe.txt | head; tail -4 /tmp/t101-probe.txt
